basic_info.description: Prime Russian Hill- just half a block from vibrant Polk St. Beautifully remodeled two-bedroom, two-full-bath Edwardian flat with elegant modern finishes and elements of authentic original charm, including Bay windows bathed in southern light. While maintaining a warm ambiance, the open-  concept layout creates a seamless flow between the living, dining, and kitchen areas, perfect for hosting gatherings. Bay windows and high ceilings add a touch of elegance  and sophistication to the space, ceiling fans in each bedroom provide a modern touch. The well-appointed Kitchen is a chef's dream,   with with a six-burner range, quartz kitchen island that converts to full table, and tall wine refrigerator. An exclusive large office area is prepped with Cat6 for high speed Internet. In-Unit Laundry, elegant bookshelves, and closet space! A well maintained building with roof deck that offers a serene retreat with City views, perfect for gardening, unwinding after a long day,  or enjoying a morning coffee.  Nestled in Russian Hill, this home is  surrounded by a myriad of amenities. Enjoy  the convenience of being just a stone's throw away  from the best of upper Polk St. Convenient location w/easy access to shuttles, major highways, public transportation. Secured leased parking paid for 1 year
